sql:
SELECT runtime.*
         FROM runtimes AS runtime
         LEFT JOIN runtimes AS newer
           ON newer.bee_id = runtime.bee_id AND newer.generation > runtime.generation
         WHERE newer.bee_id IS NULL
         ORDER BY runtime.bee_id
